description: Defines the core dispatcher interface, operator handle classes, registration mechanisms, and dispatch functions for the PyTorch ATen library.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages operator registration, lookup, and dispatching in the ATen framework.

classes.name: OperatorHandle
classes.description: Handle to a registered operator schema, used for invoking kernels and querying operator info.

classes.name: TypedOperatorHandle
classes.description: Templated handle for calling operators with specific function signatures.

classes.name: OpRegistrationListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to operator registration and deregistration events.

methods.name: findSchema
methods.description: Finds an operator schema by name, returns optional OperatorHandle.

methods.name: findSchemaOrThrow
methods.description: Finds an operator schema by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: findOp
methods.description: Finds an operator handle by name, even if no schema is registered.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes an operator with specified arguments.

methods.name: redispatch
methods.description: Re-dispatches an operator call with a specific dispatch key set.

methods.name: callBoxed
methods.description: Calls an operator via boxed (IValue stack) interface.

methods.name: registerImpl
methods.description: Registers a kernel implementation for an operator.

methods.name: registerPythonModule
methods.description: Registers a Python module as an implementation for an operator.

methods.name: registerFallback
methods.description: Registers a fallback kernel for a dispatch key.

methods.name: addRegistrationListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for operator registration events.
